title: Credit card, handbag and cushion to the bedroom
why_original: Wrong order. The task says card, then handbag, then cushion. The robot moves the cushion before the handbag, so everything ends up in the right place but the task still fails.
why_rl: The robot follows the order: card, handbag, cushion.

title: Jug and cup to the kitchen, fill the jug
why_original: The house's only faucet is in the bathroom. The robot carries the jug there, leaves it, and declares itself done. The jug is never filled or brought back, and the partner waits until time runs out.
why_rl: The robot takes the jug to the bathroom and brings it back to the kitchen, and the partner fills it.

title: Laptop, phone stand, monitor stand, file sorter to the bedroom
why_original: The robot puts all four items on the bed. The task says the table, so none of the conditions are met.
why_rl: The robot and partner split the items and put all four on the table, in less than half the steps.

title: Milk frother cup and knife to the dining room, fill, lamp on, clean
why_original: The robot keeps carrying the cup around while the partner is trying to fill it. The partner gives up and waits: the cup stays empty, the lamp stays off and the counter stays dirty.
why_rl: The robot leaves the cup with the partner, who fills it, turns on the lamp and cleans the counter.

title: Candle, book and vase to the dining room
why_original: All the items reach the table, but in two separate groups, so they aren't all next to each other. The robot stops there.
why_rl: From the same two groups, the robot goes back and moves the candle over, which finishes the task. The episode then runs to the step limit because the partner never declares itself done.

title: Clean the garage bench, bring the book and lamp, lamp on
why_original: This one is the partner's failure. The robot does its part, but the partner keeps trying to pick up the lamp and never turns it on. Only the partner can switch things on.
why_rl: The robot moves the lamp and book, and the partner cleans the bench and turns on the lamp.

title: Hammer and screwdriver to the cabinet (both models succeed)
why_original: Succeeds, but the partner repeats some of the robot's work.
why_rl: Succeeds in fewer steps, with less repeated work.

title: Lamp, spoon and fork to the living room table (both fail)
why_original: All three items reach the table, but the "next to each other" conditions aren't met.
why_rl: Same failure: the items reach the table but aren't placed next to each other.

title: Vase, doll and basketball to the lobby (the original wins)
why_original: Succeeds. The episode then runs to the step limit because the partner never declares itself done.
why_rl: Everything reaches the chest of drawers, but the basketball must be next to both other items, and it isn't.
